newsitem.title: USA: N.Y.S Environmental Facilities plans Dec bond sale.
newsitem.headline: N.Y.S Environmental Facilities plans Dec bond sale.

text.p: The New York Environmental Facilities Corp on Wednesday said that it planned to sell as much as $66 million of refunding bonds on December 23, as well as approximately $175 million of new money bonds in March.
James Gebhardt, chief financial officer, said, "We're looking to price on December 23," adding that the date still must be cleared by the state comptroller.
The syndicate for the December 23 refunding includes members of the team the agency picked in 1995, and the book-runner will be Reinoso & Co, the official said.
First Albany Corp will be the co-senior manager, and the other syndicate members are Bear, Stearns & Co, Smith Barney and Pryor, McClendon, Counts & Co.
The New York State Public Authorities Control Board approved the bond sale on Wednesday.

A syndicate has yet to be chosen for the $175 million new money sale planned for March, though the bonds, which will be used to capitalize the revolving loan fund, will be sold through negotiation, Gebhardt said.
